posts.name: Silverleaf
posts.cooked:
I love DW Fixer. He entirely eliminates the tendency to have nothing good to play later in the game because you're all set up and don't have a one-shot or Bloody Knuckles.

And you really have to think about what you want to play and whether you actually want to use Bitter Strike, and interesting decisions make the game more fun.

But then I'm one of those weird "play your hand, not your deck" type players.

It is exactly for this reason that I like to try these heroes in different team combinations.

According to the My Turn! event Google document, I’ve played him with at least ten different teams (maybe one or two more; can’t be sure about those Vengeance Five fights), and every time he’s been a drag on my momentum. posts.name: Medic-Tank
posts.cooked: DW FIxer feels just right in my hands,  I usually don't pick on stuff other heroes played unless they kindly offer, but the simplicity of using a Jack Handle for a 3-5 damage a turn with your own cards is just awesome it's like being able to use any cards in your deck as Hollow Points with a SMG or even as a rampage but without the hero damage with bloody knuckles. You also get to see the best of Riveting Crane as it finally is able to pass most DR's on it's own. When you run out of stuff to destroy you salvage yard your and your partner's equipment back to hand for more tool time... As a whole I have more fun with DW Fixer than original, but I go with what the randomiser gives me.

posts.name: Kyle24
posts.cooked:
For me the strongest and most versatile team would be :Team Leader Legacy, Visionary, Tempest, And Unity.
With Legacy he can stop incoming attacks and act as a buffer for the other heroes while also acting as a tank and taking damage so the other wont

Visionary. She can really control the game she can what cards are coming and also help get that one ongoing card Legacy needs to stop the Villain from playing cards. Not to mention with a good buff from legacy she can also deal damage

Tempest. I use him mainly for his heals. He downpour is an amazing card and he can heal everyone twice as fast as ArgentAdept also he can act as a dps with moves like chain lighting and he can get rid of environment cards

Unity. With Visionary in the game Unity can bring out her bots fast. Not to mention when she gets her raptor bots out and them stacked with Legacys buffs she’s pretty powerful.

Id be willing to exchange Unity though for omnitron x because like Unity once he gets his cards out he can deal immense damage

posts.name: tzgardner
posts.cooked:
Team Leader Tachyon, Argent Adept, Unity, Tempest

 

TLT - Allows team to draw lots of cards, dealing damage, get rid of ongoing/environment

             -I like her going first so everyone else starts game with 5 cards in hand

AA - Allow Unity to play lots of cards, heals team, gets cards back from trash, and get rid of ongoing/environment

             -Favorite setup:  Alacritous Subdominant, Inventive Preparation, and Telamon's Lyra

             -I also like the Silver Shadow/Vernal Sonata combo after he is setup

Unity - Deals damage, protects heros with Stealth Bot

Tempest - Deals damage and lots of other versatile abilities.  Works great with AA letting him play multiple cards a turn.
